band.label: Diet not eaten
band.text: 2 of 4 rated feedings carrying the trial diet left unfinished (entries with the diet in them, treats included) on 2 days between Sep 21 and Oct 8; no trial-diet feeding rated since shows whether that has changed. Trial diet: Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Dry / Royal Canin Selected Protein PR, Wet / Rayne Clinical Nutrition RABBIT - RAYNE REWARDS S.I.T. / Instinct Limited Ingredient Diet Real Rabbit Recipe in Savory Gravy / Rabbit Meat Cooked Rabbit / Vital Essentials Freeze-Dried Raw Rabbit Bites. Dates covered: Sep 16 – Oct 20, 2026. Refusal of a prescribed diet is a clinical finding in its own right , not a preference. In cats, ≥48–72 h of markedly reduced intake is a hepatic-lipidosis risk window. Shown because it is present in the log; it is not a measure of how much was eaten overall. Intake ratings on the sheet headed “Intake per feeding”.

band.text: 6 vomiting entries in the last 7 days, on 3 days in a row. A high count on its own, with no earlier week needed to compare. The owner was told to call the vet soon.

band.text: Weighed 3.73 kg ( 8.2 lb) on Sep 16, 2026 on a home scale, a single reading, down from 4.40 kg ( 9.7 lb) on Jun 15, 2026 on a home scale, a single reading — about 15 % of body weight. The latest reading against the highest before it in the last 365 days, not a diagnosis; body condition was not assessed. The owner was told it is worth booking a vet visit.

band.label: Chronicity
band.text: Vomiting spans 44 days (first logged Sep 17): 14 episodes on 12 days; most recent today. A sustained pattern over many samples, not a single incident. Cough and vomiting are both flagged chronic for this patient. Post-tussive vomiting, and cough mistaken for hairball retching, are common in both directions, so either count may be understated as readily as overstated — both are owner-classified, reported separately and un-reclassified. This window opens Sep 16, so 44 days is a floor — the record cannot show how long the sign predates it.
